headline_en: Mumbai Police questioned IIT Bombay Professor Suryanarayana Doolla for hours
headline_hi: मुंबई पुलिस ने आईआईटी बॉम्बे के प्रोफेसर सूर्यनारायण डूल्ला से घंटों पूछताछ की
summary: IIT Bombay stated that Mr. Wakode was allegedly caught using his mobile phone to access ChatGPT during a mid-semester examination on September 18. Following student protests, the institute sent Professor Doolla on leave and removed him from all his positions.

headline_en: FSSAI ordered recall of Everest cumin powder for pesticide residues
headline_hi: कीटनाशक अवशेषों के लिए FSSAI ने एवरेस्ट जीरा पाउडर को वापस मंगाने का आदेश दिया
summary: On Sunday, FSSAI ordered the recall of Everest Food Products' cumin powder from the market and suspended the food license of Creative Bakers and Confectioners Pvt Ltd.

headline_en: Delhi Crime Branch investigates sexual harassment complaints filed by three female journalists
headline_hi: दिल्ली क्राइम ब्रांच ने तीन महिला पत्रकारों द्वारा दर्ज कराई गई यौन उत्पीड़न की शिकायतों की जाँच की
summary: Reports said that on Friday, Bharadwaj and Jha were detained by police, and Bharadwaj shared a video on X and spoke to ANI minutes before his detention. On Saturday, security forces detained approximately 150 people at Jantar Mantar, where three women journalists participated in the protest.

headline_en: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan calls mass voter disenfranchisement arbitrary and unconstitutional
headline_hi: न्यायमूर्ति उज्ज्वल भुयान बड़े पैमाने पर मतदाताओं के मताधिकार से वंचित किए जाने को मनमाना और असंवैधानिक बताते हैं
summary: According to reports, the Special Intensive Revision process was first initiated by the Election Commission in Bihar in June 2025. Later, on September 22, 2026, a Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant requested a response from the Election Commission regarding the voter list revision.

headline_en: Fire brigade extinguishes blaze on Ramayana film set in Mumbai
headline_hi: फायर ब्रिगेड ने मुंबई में रामायण फिल्म के सेट पर आग बुझाई
summary: Reports differ on whether a fire broke out on Monday, 5 October 2026, on the set of the film 'Ramayana' or the television show 'Hustle 5' at Film City in Goregaon, Mumbai. The fire brigade extinguished the fire at 4:55 PM that day, and no injuries were reported.

headline_en: Donald Trump posted on Truth Social about Brazil election voting numbers
headline_hi: Donald Trump ने ब्राजील चुनाव के मतदान के आंकड़ों के बारे में Truth Social पर पोस्ट किया
summary: Brazil held the first round of its presidential election on Sunday. According to reports, on Monday, Indian time, Donald Trump posted on his social media platform Truth Social regarding election voting numbers.

headline_en: PM Modi and Swiss President Parmelin hold talks in New Delhi
headline_hi: पीएम मोदी और स्विस राष्ट्रपति परमेलीन ने नई दिल्ली में बातचीत की
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Swiss Confederation president Guy Parmelin held talks in New Delhi on Monday. Earlier in the day, President Parmelin arrived in New Delhi and was accorded a ceremonial reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan before visiting Rajghat.

headline_en: Jammu and Kashmir authorities deport 150 Bangladeshi nationals via air
headline_hi: जम्मू और कश्मीर के अधिकारियों ने 150 बांग्लादेशी नागरिकों को हवाई मार्ग से देश से निकाला
summary: According to reports, Jammu and Kashmir authorities deported 150 Bangladeshi nationals from Srinagar to Bagdogra via an Indian Air Force aircraft on Monday, 05 October 2026, shifting them to West Bengal as part of a deportation process.

headline_en: Congress appoints Imran Masood working president in Uttar Pradesh reshuffle
headline_hi: कांग्रेस ने उत्तर प्रदेश फेरबदल में इमरान मसूद को कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष नियुक्त किया
summary: The Congress party appointed Imran Masood as working president on Saturday, 03 October 2026. According to reports, the party carried out an organizational reshuffle in Uttar Pradesh on that day, and Aradhana Mishra 'Mona', named in some reports as Ajay Rai, was appointed president of the Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee.

headline_en: Co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami allegedly assaulted captain on FlyDubai flight to Tel Aviv
headline_hi: को-पायलट Hamam al-Hammami ने कथित तौर पर Tel Aviv जाने वाली FlyDubai उड़ान पर कैप्टन पर हमला किया
summary: According to reports, an incident occurred on September 30 aboard Flydubai Flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, during which Captain Smit Machchhar was attacked by his co-pilot inside the cockpit. According to reports, the Omani co-pilot was identified as Hamam al-Hammami.

headline_en: Delhi High Court dismisses petitions seeking FIRs against Kapil Mishra and Parvesh Verma
headline_hi: दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय ने कपिल मिश्रा और प्रवेश वर्मा के खिलाफ एफआईआर दर्ज करने की मांग वाली याचिकाएं खारिज कीं
summary: On Monday, the Delhi High Court dismissed petitions requesting the registration of FIRs against Kapil Mishra and Parvesh Verma regarding alleged hate speeches connected to the 2020 riots. According to reports, the court also rejected pleas seeking action against police officers for alleged failure in duty.

headline_en: Bengaluru police arrest prison DIG M. Somashekar over convict release
headline_hi: बेंगलुरु पुलिस ने कैदी की रिriहाई को लेकर जेल DIG एम. सोमशेखर को गिरफ्तार किया
summary: Parappana Agrahara police arrested M. Somashekar, the Deputy Inspector General of Prisons in Kalaburagi, in Bengaluru on Monday, October 5, 2026. The current superintendent of Bengaluru Central Jail filed a complaint at Parappana Agrahara police station on May 20, 2026, regarding the release of a convict.

headline_en: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari pledges UCC within six months
headline_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी ने छह महीने के भीतर यूसीसी का संकल्प लिया
summary: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari stated on Sunday 04 October 2026 that West Bengal is set to implement the Uniform Civil Code within the next six months. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari stated that his government would introduce stringent laws within six months.

headline_en: Supreme Court orders Delhi Police to prioritize crime prevention over reaction
headline_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने दिल्ली पुलिस को प्रतिक्रिया के बजाय अपराध की रोकथाम को प्राथमिकता देने का आदेश दिया
summary: On Monday, the Supreme Court heard a suo motu case over recent rape cases and other crimes against women in Delhi-NCR. The Supreme Court told the Centre and Delhi Police that the focus should be on preventing crimes rather than dealing with them after they have occurred.

headline_en: Supreme Court issues notices to Election Commission, dismisses CEC suspension plea
headline_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने चुनाव आयोग को नोटिस जारी किए, सीईसी के निलंबन की याचिका खारिज की
summary: The Supreme Court of India dismissed an interim petition seeking the suspension of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Monday 5 October 2026. The Supreme Court bench issued notices to the Centre, the Election Commission, CEC Gyanesh Kumar, Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, Deputy Election Commissioner Manish Garg, and DG (IT) Seema Khanna on Monday 05 October 20

headline_en: Supreme Court to hear petitions seeking suspension of CEC Gyanesh Kumar
headline_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट CEC ज्ञानेश कुमार को निलंबित करने की मांग वाली याचिकाओं पर सुनवाई करेगा
summary: The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a batch of petitions seeking the suspension of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and challenging decisions allegedly taken by the poll panel on Monday, October 5, 2026.

headline_en: Supreme Court issues notice to Election Commission over Form-6 changes
headline_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने फॉर्म-6 में बदलाव को लेकर निर्वाचन आयोग को नोटिस जारी किया
summary: The Supreme Court declined to issue any interim order on Monday to suspend Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, while also issuing notice to the Election Commission of India and its three commissioners on the plea.
